title: Skiplagged Hotel Reviews Scraper
description: Collect public reviews from one or more Skiplagged hotel URLs with sorting, filtering, result limits, pagination caps, and mandatory Apify Residential Proxy routing.

startUrls.title: Skiplagged hotel URLs
startUrls.description: One or more public Skiplagged hotel URLs. Hotel URLs with or without stay dates are supported.

sortBy.title: Sort reviews
sortBy.description: Order reviews before they are saved.

filter.title: Review filter
filter.description: Keep all reviews, reviews with text, or reviews in a rating group.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of review records to save across all supplied hotel URLs.

max_pages.title: Maximum review pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of 50-review output pages to process per hotel. The source returns the available review set in one response, so this caps local batching.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Residential Proxy is mandatory for Skiplagged requests and is enabled automatically. This Actor does not send requests directly.
